author: Riilo
body:
This map was made by Seuth and myself. (thank Notch for the name ;-
STILL A WORK IN PROGRESS. The map is going to be changed from feedback/suggestions.
Yet another map using the clay palette! I am going to change that then possible.

Images: http://imgur.com/a/5ISaA
YML: http://pastebin.com/XLX9mctN
Download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/x2mk01az98vl448/MAP%21%21%21%21%21%21%21%21%21%21%21%21%21%21%21%21%21%21%...

Leave feedback below please, besides "Change the block palette," as I am working on that.

FEATURES: 
2 Arrow spawners:
1 Gapple Spawner
1 underbridge per side
1 middle bridge
And a whole lot of shit
